entities.name: Table T1 – Crypto Market – Daily Price Movements of Bitcoin and Ethereum
entities.brief: Daily BTC and ETH spot prices
entities.description: Time series of daily Bitcoin and Ethereum spot prices from Jan 1 to Jul 25, 2025

properties.key_insight: Ethereum showed a more rapid and sustained ascent since April, culminating in a strong July surge to around $3,800, compared to Bitcoin's mid-July peak near $123,000 before retracing.

entities.name: Table T1 – Crypto Annualized Basis History
entities.brief: Annualized futures basis for ETH and BTC (2021-2025)
entities.description: Key indicator of market sentiment via contango/backwardation trends

properties.key_insight: ETH and BTC futures basis shifted from strong contango over 30% and 20% in early 2021 to deep backwardation around -20% and -15% in late 2022, recovering to about 5-10% by 2025 with ETH more volatile.

entities.name: Crypto Futures Basis Sentiment
entities.brief: Market sentiment indicator from futures basis
entities.description: Bullish or bearish sentiment based on ETH and BTC futures premium/discount

entities.name: Table T2 – Crypto Spot Price History
entities.brief: 5-year spot price history for BTC and ETH
entities.description: Shows price volatility and bull market cycles in top two cryptocurrencies

properties.key_insight: Bitcoin and Ethereum prices showed strong bull runs in late 2020-2021 and 2024-2025, with BTC reaching over $125,000 and ETH near $4,800 by July 2025 amid significant volatility.

entities.name: Crypto BTCUSD Price Peak
